messages.author: 7001a5e5d7399741
messages.subject: Poor ShinyApp performance
parts:
Hi,

I'm enrolled in Coursera's Data Science Specialization, currently working in the Capstone Project. I have uploaded a text prediction tool to ShinyApps but the performance is considerably poor. Normally, I would blame myself :), but when I run it from R Studio I get predictions in less than 5 seconds... however with the online version, I can sometimes get one prediction and then the app hangs when I retry or it just hangs in the first prediction (and I mean it REALLY hangs, the browser doesn't even refreshes or just tells me to "please wait" forever.

I have a free account, and I know that there are some resources limitations... however I still have less than 20 hours of usage (out of which it has never worked, but let's not go there), and my profile's performance monitors show that I have never reached the 500MB memory usage limit.

Is there something I can check in my profile or my code? or is this something that needs to be looked at from the architecture perspective?

link to my app: https://dabergueiro.shinyapps.io/CapstoneProject/

messages.subject: Re: Poor ShinyApp performance
parts:
I'm still struggling with this... I've scaled down  my app to very simple functionality, and from the performance pics you can see a drastic change in performance (CPU & Memory consumption). The app is more responsive now, but it still hangs  after the 3rd or 4th prediction.  I did see some things in the  logs this time however.

Now, I ran exactly the same predictions in parallel online and on my local version, and I know  that the code doesn't cause any "NA cohersion" so I'm guessing that the "Bad signature" and the "unexpected ends of streams" are causing those to happen (and the app crashing until I restart the whole thing in ShinyApps).

My question now is... how do I troubleshoot this if it only happens online but the local version runs smootly?
